name: comp-163

frames.best_why: The PayPal tile carries the brightest outline, the most legible sign of a chosen method, with all three tiles in view.

tagline: Three payment tiles; the chosen one takes a brighter outline.
summary: A row of three equal tiles for Card, PayPal and Apple Pay, each with a payment icon above its name. Picking a tile lights up its border so the selected method reads at a glance.
appearance: Three rounded rectangles sit in a row on a black page, each with a thin grey outline, a dark fill and a white line icon over a small white caption. The tiles are the same size, evenly spaced, with wide black gaps between them.
behaviour: Clicking a tile moves a lighter outline to it. The recording opens with Card outlined and later shows PayPal outlined; nothing else on the tile moves.
search_phrases: choose card paypal or apple pay
select how to pay at checkout
three payment options in one row
use_when: At checkout, when a buyer must pick one of a few offered or saved payment methods.
avoid_when: Each tile holds only an icon and a name, so a method that needs fees or a short explanation has no room.
customise: The three tiles, their icon imports and their captions are written in the file; swap them there. Add a method by copying a tile block and changing its icon and value.
weight_why: Three bordered tiles with inline icons and one short border fade.

a11y.note: The radios are hidden but stay focusable, each with a real label and a ring on the whole tile; the border fade ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: Selection is only a faint border, easy to miss when the tiles sit on black.
Captions are very small compared with the tile area.
polish_why: Clean alignment and equal tiles, but the chosen state is quiet and the captions small.
